Formally return the expired items to the original equipment supplier demanding a full monetary refund

questions.subject: Financial Administration and Office Procedure
questions.question_english: A vendor supplies laboratory equipment to a school through the GeM portal. The Principal notices that some equipment is defective. What is the appropriate administrative procedure to follow?
options_english: Auction or sell the defective laboratory equipment in the open market to recover cost
Write off the financial loss directly by adjusting it in the office contingent register
Raise an incident or reject supply on GeM portal within time for replacement or refund
Pay the vendor in full and separately purchase new replacement items from local market
questions.explanation_english: When defective items are delivered via the Government e-Marketplace, the buying authority must raise an official incident or reject the consignment on the portal within the stipulated timeline. This administrative procedure holds the seller accountable and ensures mandatory replacement or full refund under terms of online procurement contracts.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (c) है। जब दोषपूर्ण वस्तुएं सरकारी ई-मार्केटप्लेस के माध्यम से वितरित की जाती हैं, तो खरीद प्राधिकरण को निर्धारित समय सीमा के भीतर आधिकारिक घटना उठानी चाहिए या पोर्टल पर आपूर्ति को अस्वीकार करना चाहिए। यह प्रशासनिक प्रक्रिया विक्रेता को जिम्मेदार ठहराती है और ऑनलाइन खरीद अनुबंधों की शर्तों के तहत अनिवार्य प्रतिस्थापन या पूर्ण धनवापसी सुनिश्चित करती है।
key_facts: Defective items must be reported on GeM portal within stipulated time.
Administrative procedures ensure accountability of suppliers.
Printed answer key: (C) Raise an incident or reject supply on GeM

questions.question_hindi: केंद्रीय सिविल सेवा (अनुशासन और अपील) नियम 1965 के तहत कौन सी सजा 'छोटी सजा' के रूप में वर्गीकृत की जाती है?
questions.source: AI-generated from supplied reference material; Delhi Government School Admission Guidelines
questions.subject: Financial Administration and Office Procedure
questions.question_english: Which penalty under the CCS (CCA) Rules 1965 is classified as a ‘Minor Penalty’?
options_english: Reduction to a lower time-scale of pay
questions.explanation_english: Under the Central Civil Services Classification, Control and Appeal Rules 1965, the withholding of increments of pay is explicitly categorized as a minor penalty. Conversely, penalties such as compulsory retirement, reduction to a lower time-scale, and dismissal from service represent major administrative penalties requiring elaborate disciplinary inquiry procedures prior to imposition.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (b) है। केंद्रीय सिविल सेवा (अनुशासन और अपील) नियम 1965 के तहत वेतन की वृद्धि को रोकना स्पष्ट रूप से छोटी सजा के रूप में वर्गीकृत किया गया है। इसके विपरीत, अनिवार्य सेवानिवृत्ति, कम वेतनमान पर कमी, और सेवा से बर्खास्तगी जैसी सजाएँ प्रमुख प्रशासनिक सजाएँ हैं, जिनके लिए लागू करने से पहले विस्तृत अनुशासनात्मक जांच प्रक्रियाएँ आवश्यक होती हैं।
key_facts: Withholding of increments of pay is a minor penalty.
Major penalties require elaborate disciplinary inquiries.
Reduction to a lower time-scale and dismissal are major penalties.
Printed answer key: (B) Withholding of increments of pay
